items.title: Additions to the Entity List (BIS adds 7 Megaspeed-linked entities in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand)
items.excerpt: BIS final rule (public inspection 11-23, publication 11-25) adds MSFusion, PT Megaspeed International, Speedmatrix, Apex Enterprise Solutions (Singapore), Megaspeed International Pte, Swiftdata and Megaspeed (Thailand) to the Entity List over significant risk of diverting advanced computing commodities; all EAR items need a license, presumption of denial. Effective on public inspection.

history_match.title: Joint statement from Department of Commerce and Department of Justice on Megaspeed investigation

items.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
items.excerpt: Oregon and Virginia attorneys general filed suits against SpaceX/X over Grok image generation, alleging the AI still produces CSAM and nonconsensual intimate imagery despite X's claim every output is screened.

items.title: States Sue SpaceX Over Grok Deepfakes
items.excerpt: The attorneys general of Oregon and Virginia are suing several of Elon Musk's companies, alleging weak safeguards against sexualized AI imagery of real people, including children.

history_match.title: Texas becomes the latest state to sue OpenAI

items.title: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok's porn deepfakes
items.excerpt: State AGs called the weak safeguards built into Grok's AI image generator 'not a failure but a feature' in new lawsuits against SpaceX, which owns X and xAI.

items.title: White House brags that Trump was 'totally involved' in getting Jensen reinstated
items.excerpt: The White House said President Trump was 'totally involved' in Nvidia's board reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO, with Trump saying Huang 'did nothing wrong' amid the national-security probe tied to AI chip diversion to China.

history_match.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned by Congress over Chinese espionage concerns

items.title: Huang's return sparks bipartisan backlash on Capitol Hill
items.excerpt: Senators in both parties questioned Nvidia's 'no national security risk' finding; House Intelligence, Foreign Affairs and China committees say Huang's scheduled testimony next week on AI chip diversion is unchanged.

items.title: 트럼프, 젠슨황에 '안보 면죄부'…AI패권·스캔들 불똥 의식했나
items.excerpt: 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO의 전격 복귀에 트럼프 대통령의 역할이 결정적이었던 것으로 나타나, 미 정부가 사실상 '안보 면죄부'를 준 배경으로 AI 패권 경쟁과 스캔들 확산 우려가 거론된다.

items.title: AI data centers throw another wrench into chaotic UN climate talks
items.excerpt: AI data center electricity demand became a flashpoint at the COP31 UN climate talks, complicating national energy and emissions commitments.

items.title: AI in Mental Health Airlock to support safe innovation
items.excerpt: The UK launches a new regulatory sandbox ('AI Airlock' for mental health) to explore how safety of AI-enabled digital mental health technologies can be evaluated and regulated.

items.title: AI 안경 '몰카' 막는다…촬영 표시 의무화 법안 발의
items.excerpt: AI 스마트안경에 촬영 표시 기능 탑재를 의무화하고 사적 촬영 시 촬영 사실 고지를 의무화하는 법안(이주희 의원 대표발의)이 국회에 발의됐다.

items.title: 배경훈 부총리 "국가과학AI센터, 과학AI 허브 자리잡도록 지원"
items.excerpt: 과기정통부가 국가과학인공지능연구센터(NAIS)를 중심으로 국가 과학 AI 역량을 결집하는 계획을 밝혔다 (과기정통부 11-23 보도자료 '국가 과학 인공지능 역량 결집해 초지능 과학 혁신을 선도한다').

items.title: Inside the Black Market for America's Artificial Intelligence
items.excerpt: A network of resellers illegally sells China access to top American AI models; the piece argues Washington already has export-control and sanctions tools to go after them.

items.title: OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits
items.excerpt: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki released perplexity scores for the GPT series and proposed that labs agree on shared capability limits, a governance proposal for frontier AI.

items.title: Chinese military fears AI could let the US find and destroy its nuclear missiles
items.excerpt: Chinese military researchers warn AI advances could give the US an edge in the nuclear balance by locating mobile missile launchers.

items.title: US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year
items.excerpt: Per the NYT, US intelligence tracked Alice Huang's contacts with China's MSS for over a year; investigators are probing whether a network of companies diverted Nvidia AI chips to China.

history_match.title: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China

items.title: Doctors who disagree with AI could face legal jeopardy
items.excerpt: Mock-jury research finds juries side with plaintiffs more when AI disagrees with a radiologist; the AMA has called for federal and state laws shielding clinicians from AI liability.

history_match.title: Doctors want liability shield from AI mistakes

items.title: NY Gov. Hochul vetoes bill that would have required AI accuracy warnings
items.excerpt: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul vetoed a bill requiring AI chatbots to carry accuracy warnings, saying the measure may run afoul of free-speech protections. Off-list exception: on-list outlets had no item on this state veto.

items.excerpt: Essay on how AI agents could transform government administration and public services.
